algorithm: {For each bin, if the item fits, compute the priority score as the negative of the average wasted space per item when packing the maximum possible number of the item into the bin, otherwise assign negative infinity, such that higher scores indicate more preferred bins for adding the item.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    k = np.floor(bins / item)
    waste_per_item = (bins - k * item) / k
    return np.where(bins >= item, -waste_per_item, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    fit_mask = bins >= item
    total_items = np.floor(bins / item)
    remainder = bins % item
    scores = total_items - remainder ** 2
    return np.where(fit_mask, scores, -np.inf)
